text_block_list.text: On New Year's Day, while in the Trainer's room――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it. The lights were on,
so I figured you were here. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with you again this year"... and sent.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What, it's just a New Year's greeting.
It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Also this. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's gift. I mean, you are my
Trainer, after all. You do take care of me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why are you so touched?
Isn't this just normal...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, that takes care of the pleasantries.
How about we get right down to our first run?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, it's our Classic campaign.
We need to stay sharp right from day one.
choice_data_list: We need to come up with a strategy too.
I'll make sure to collect accurate data.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
It's just as you say."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Then after our running drills, how about we study our opponents?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, there's so much to do right from the start of the new year.
Seriously, there's no time to slack off.

"And right at the start of the New Year,
Daiwa Scarlet and I proceeded with preparations for the next race."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I know that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, pointless breaks are unnecessary.
You understand that too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly. You're great at giving energetic answers, at least.

Afterward, keeping a close eye on her physical condition,
we wrapped up our first day of training in the new year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, so you're fired up too, huh?
I like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, stop slacking off
and let's get right into distance running!!
With a satisfied expression, Daiwa Scarlet raced across the track.
